title: Vulnerability of LLMs’ Belief Systems? LLMs Belief Resistance Check Through Strategic Persuasive Conversation Interventions
reasoning: The paper focuses on the robustness of LLM 'belief systems' against persuasion in factual, medical, and social bias domains. While it touches on the epistemological nature of LLM stances and social bias involves ethical judgments, it does not specifically benchmark religious faith, spiritual traditions, or core moral/ethical philosophies as a primary component.
